title: A built project's chat answers about the project: how to improve it, from its own records
request: I asked in the chat how we can improve the model (it was built): is the answer right?
spec: The Home chat of a built project ran the plan-building agent, so a question about improving the model got the plan summary again.
plan: Route a message on a built chat to the project's records, not the plan turn
An improve intent in the project answer agent that reads advice out of the numbers
Render the advice as a list with its cited rules

decisions.decision: Each suggestion appears only when a number in the records supports it (an interval too wide, a gap between the folds and the holdout, models within one fold spread, the recipe chosen, tuning's gain, the cutoff).
decisions.why: An answer about a model must rest on its evidence, not on general advice; a record without the evidence gets only where it stands.

decisions.decision: The route changes for a built draft only; an open draft's chat is unchanged.
decisions.why: The plan-building turn is right until the project is built.

change: draft/chat.py (reply_built), draft/api.py (message route), studio/agent.py (improvements, IMPROVE), views/home.html (project_answer message), tests/test_built_chat.py.

findings.defect: Asked how to improve a built model, the chat summarised the plan again.
findings.scenario: After a project was built, the person reopened its chat and asked how to improve the model; the reply was Here is the solution I would build.
findings.cause: The messages route sent every message to the plan-building agent, whatever the draft's status; the reopened chat (an earlier fix) made it reachable.
findings.fix: A built draft's messages are answered from the project's records; the project answer agent gained an improve intent.

measurements.name: The improve answer on a project's records
measurements.gate: each suggestion cites a number in the records; none without its evidence
measurements.result: with the shapes of a real project: where it stands with its interval and baseline, more cases (interval 0.1 wide), the fold-to-holdout gap, models within one spread, the recipe, tuning, the cutoff
limits: advice from numbers is general: it names where to look, it does not run the experiments

outcome: A person asking a built project's chat how to improve it gets advice read from that project's own numbers.
lessons: A feature that makes a state reachable (reopening a built chat) must check what the next step does in that state.
risks: A model-written answer (llm_answer) is used when a model serves the purpose; its quality was not measured.
